desc: Crafted for performance and beauty, the Fierce Upland Over/Under Field Shotgun is the result of a unique collaboration between Fierce Firearms and master gunsmiths from Italy’s renowned Val Trompia Valley. Designed with the discerning upland hunter in mind, this shotgun delivers both timeless elegance and dependable function in the field. The Upland is made in Italy. The side plate box lock receiver features a stunning case color finish or coin finish accented by gold inlaid game birds, capturing the classic aesthetic of traditional over/under shotguns. Its Turkish walnut stock is not only visually striking but also ergonomically shaped, complete with a checkered grip and pistol grip for a natural hold and fast target acquisition. The blued barrels are internally treated with a chrome moly finish, ensuring exceptional durability and top-tier performance. Whether you’re walking a pheasant field or breaking clays, the Fierce Upland delivers the confidence, reliability, and craftsmanship you demand from a premium firearm. It comes with a lifetime limited warranty.
